'''Westen''' was an officer in the [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]]. He became a captain soon after the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].

==Biography==
Westen became the [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] [[Relentless (Dorja)|''Relentless'']]<ref name="Rules Companion">''[[The Star Wars Rules Companion]]''</ref> after the previous captain, [[Ranif Parlan|Parlan]], failed in a mission ordered by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]]. Parlan had been sent to capture Republican tactician [[Adar Tallon/Legends|Adar Tallon]], who was hiding on [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. However, Tallon [[Escape from Tatooine|escaped]] from Parlan's agent and joined the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]]. Because of his mistake, Parlan was strangled by [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Vader.<ref name="Tatooine Manhunt">''[[Tatooine Manhunt]]''</ref> Westen had a chance to fight Adar Tallon, the man who escaped from his predecessor. Commanding the ''Relentless'', Westen [[Battle of Heterkus|fought]] the new flagship of the Rebel commander, ''[[Silent Water]]''. Tallon considered different tactics to use in the fight, and one of the factors he pondered was that Westen was not at all like Parlan.<ref name="Rules Companion" />

Later, [[Moff/Legends|Moff]] [[Ravik/Legends|Ravik]], who had been captured by Rebels and being transported to safe word on board of ship [[Celestial (starship)|''Celestial'']], managed to escape from his cell. Working alongside commander [[Bane Nothos]] and other prisoners, Ravik had staged a [[Mutiny on the Celestial|revolt]], taking the control of the ship from her previous captain, [[Alain Gryphon]]. Ravik sent a distress signal to the nearest Imperial base. The ''Relentless'' was sent to pick up Ravik, who had also the coordinates of the Rebel safe world. However, before Westen arrived, the ''Celestial'' entered [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]] because of a final effort of Captain Gryphon. Westen, afraid of Imperial reprisals, could not afford to lose Ravik. He sent a whole wing of [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN starfighters]] to the area, to track any possible hyperspace lane that the ''Celestial'' might have used.<ref name="Otherspace" />

While the fighters were scouting, a Rebel reinforcement ship arrived; it was the ''[[Long Shot]]''. The ''Shot'' collided with one TIE and then began a conflict with Westen's forces. Westen informed a nervous [[Unidentified Imperial lieutenant (Westen)|lieutenant]] that he intended to interrogate the ''Celestial''{{'s}} destination out of the ''Long Shot''{{'s}} crew. Understanding that she was at a disadvantage, the ''Shot'' began a hyperspace jump. However, the hyperdrive on the ''Shot'' had been damage because of the initial collision with the TIE, and the ''Celestial'' also had had a damaged hyperdrive. Due to this, their hyperlanes were completely different and alien, and Westen could not track them.<ref name="Otherspace" />

Having disappointed [[Dark Lord of the Sith/Legends|Lord]] Vader, Westen was relieved of his captaincy.<ref name="CSWE Relentless">{{CSWECite|III|91|Relentless}}</ref>
